Texo handwriting/formula recognition model (AGPL-3.0, LICENSE.txt)
  Author: Sicheng Mao (alephpi). Paper: "Texo: Formula Recognition within 20M
  Parameters", arXiv 2602.17189. Code: https://github.com/alephpi/Texo
  Web app the files came from: https://github.com/alephpi/Texo-web,
  models/model/ at commit 4cff3bcff82846b31d7c1207d883e1b29d2b7db0
  (same files as Hugging Face alephpi/FormulaNet).

Changes made for MathVox (October 2026):
  The fp32 ONNX files (encoder 54MB, decoder 26MB) were quantized to 8-bit
  with onnxruntime.quantization.quantize_dynamic (weight_type QUInt8; the
  merged decoder with extra_options={"EnableSubgraph": True}). Saved as
  onnx/encoder_model_quantized.onnx and onnx/decoder_model_merged_quantized.onnx,
  the names Transformers.js loads for dtype "q8". CROHME 2014 test set exact
  match: 41.6% fp32, 40.6% quantized.
  config.json, generation_config.json, tokenizer.json, tokenizer_config.json
  are unchanged.
